AiSavingOut.title: AiSavingOut
AiSavingOut.description:
The AI saving the engine identified and how much of it the price passes to the client
(the rest is kept as margin; line commercial.ai_saving_kept.v1).

AssumedAnswer.title: AssumedAnswer
AssumedAnswer.description:
An answer nobody gave, priced at the usual answer: printed on the quote as assumed, to
be changed if wrong (silent defaults were behind most wrong estimates).

BaselineEra.title: BaselineEra
BaselineEra.description: Whether the effort data behind a component was measured with AI coding tools in use.

BidCheck.title: BidCheck
BidCheck.description: For a client planning a tender: the fair budget and where bids stop looking realistic.

CalibrationBasis.title: CalibrationBasis
CalibrationBasis.description:
What the effort level of these figures was calibrated against (documentation only: the
engine never reads it). Kept apart from the source era: a calibration against pre-AI data
does not make a component's own sources pre-AI.

ClientPays.title: ClientPays
ClientPays.description: A cost the client pays providers directly; not part of the price.

CodeSent.title: CodeSent
CodeSent.description: A code was emailed (or, for a reset, would be if the account exists).

CostItem.title: CostItem
CostItem.description: One plain line of "What's inside the price".

CustomFeature.title: CustomFeature
CustomFeature.description: A feature outside the ready-made list: found in the document or added by the user.

Driver.title: Driver
Driver.description: NFR drivers a catalog component can be sensitive to.

EffortEvidence.title: EffortEvidence
EffortEvidence.description: One cited source behind a component's effort figures (catalog v6+).

EraBasis.title: EraBasis
EraBasis.description:
Why an evidence item has its era. A date is only a provisional heuristic; an explicit
statement or a documented workflow takes precedence.

EraRules.title: EraRules
EraRules.description: How evidence eras are set (catalog v6+). The cutoff is a provisional heuristic.

EraSensitivityOut.title: EraSensitivityOut
EraSensitivityOut.description:
Building blocks whose effort data has unknown AI use get no AI saving in the price. This
is the same scope if that data predates AI tools (the team's AI savings applied to it):
shown beside the price, never taken off it (engine run, `era_sensitivity`).

FeatureCost.title: FeatureCost
FeatureCost.description:
Building one feature: the team's work on its building blocks (most likely), with the
team's AI tools and without them. Launch, running, management and tax are not included.

FoundInventory.title: FoundInventory
FoundInventory.description:
What the system must contain, for the independent check. The AI lists named items with
quotes; only items whose quotes are found on the page are kept, and the code counts them.
A classification the config does not know is stored as "".

FoundItem.title: FoundItem
FoundItem.description: One thing the finished system must contain (services/extraction/inventory.py).

FoundPayment.title: FoundPayment
FoundPayment.description: One payment, as an engine payment-schedule point (fractions, not percentages).

FoundScope.title: FoundScope
FoundScope.description: A scope item the document mentions (quick config `scope`), with its quotes.

FoundStaff.title: FoundStaff
FoundStaff.description: A staff line as priced from the document, with how and where it says so.

FoundStaffLine.title: FoundStaffLine
FoundStaffLine.description: A staff statement whose quote was found on its page (StaffLineFinding, normalised).

HoursRow.title: HoursRow
HoursRow.description: One role's hours over the build (the engine's person-days × hours per day).

HoursSummary.title: HoursSummary
HoursSummary.description: The build in hours: with the team's AI tools, without them, and the team's cost.

KeyAnswer.title: KeyAnswer
KeyAnswer.description:
One of the answers that move the price most, with the clause that gives it and the
pre-bid queries about it. The form orders them by `impact_paise` (GET /documents/{id}/form).

LineTrace.title: LineTrace
LineTrace.description:
The full chain for one number: clause + page -> requirement -> component -> drivers ->
rate-card entries -> formula -> value (rule 2).

MarketOut.title: MarketOut
MarketOut.description:
What real projects were bought for, next to the should-cost estimate. basis
"published_prices": the published prices of real projects the app gives the same size, in
today's money with GST (P25 / median / P75), as published, not scaled to this estimate.
"scaled_to_estimate" (parameter sets v14-v15 without benchmark data): P50 × a size band.
Either way an observed price, not a check of the hours.

NotIncluded.title: NotIncluded
NotIncluded.description:
Something the user marked "Not included": a feature, a scope item, or a standard
building block unticked. Not priced, and listed as not included on the quote.

NotIncludedOut.title: NotIncludedOut
NotIncludedOut.description:
Not in the price, and said so on the quote: marked "Not included" or unticked by the
user, left out by a "Not sure" answer (its "if required" price is a priced option of
`question_key`), ruled out by the document, or asked for there but not priced here.

PricedOption.title: PricedOption
PricedOption.description:
A question left open (not in the document, or answered "Not sure"): priced at its usual
answer, with what each other answer would change. Fast fixed-seed re-pricing (quick config
`impact`) of the estimate's own snapshot, so the changes use its pinned rates.

PricedStaff.title: PricedStaff
PricedStaff.description:
Staff the code prices from the staff lines (services/extraction/staffing.py): people at
the client's office (onsite) or elsewhere (support), with how long and why.

ResearchedFeature.title: ResearchedFeature
ResearchedFeature.description:
A feature priced by a block researched for it (services/research): from published hours
found on the web and checked on the page ("web"), or from the AI's analysis of it as catalog
blocks ("analysis"). Low confidence either way.

ResearchedOut.title: ResearchedOut
ResearchedOut.description:
A feature researched before, by this company or shared by the library (services/
research): ticked, it is sent as a custom feature with this catalog key, so it is priced
by the saved block, not searched again.

ReviewPrefill.title: ReviewPrefill
ReviewPrefill.description: The review form's starting state, and what it sends when everything is accepted.

ScopeCost.title: ScopeCost
ScopeCost.description:
A chosen scope item and the building cost of the blocks only it asked for (most likely,
split evenly when two items need the same new block). 0 = already in the project (a
feature's or a standard block), so nothing was added.

SimilarProject.title: SimilarProject
SimilarProject.description: A real project with a published price, close to this one.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: Where a requirement comes from in the tender document.

StaffItem-Input.title: StaffItem
StaffItem-Input.description:
People the vendor provides during support, from the document's staff lines (priced in
code, services/extraction/staffing.py) or added by the user (OPEN_QUESTIONS 162).

StaffItem-Output.title: StaffItem
StaffItem-Output.description:
People the vendor provides during support, from the document's staff lines (priced in
code, services/extraction/staffing.py) or added by the user (OPEN_QUESTIONS 162).

TeamRole.title: TeamRole
TeamRole.description:
People of one role: full-time people on average over the period (the build, or one
support year) and the work in person-months, from the engine's manpower rows.

TraceAnswer.title: TraceAnswer
TraceAnswer.description: A questionnaire driver used by the line, with where its value came from.

UnclearPoint.title: UnclearPoint
UnclearPoint.description: Stored form; quote is blank when it could not be found on the cited page.
